title: Returns
description: Items Customers send back, from request to Restock decision and Refund.
detailDescription: Approve, receive, decide each item's restock, then refund what the Customer paid.
search: Search by Return, Order or Customer
emptyDescription: Returns are requested from a Delivered Order's page, within the Return window.
notFound: This Return does not exist or was removed.

request.title: Return items from {{number}}
request.description: Choose how many units of each item come back and why. Stock does not change until each item's Restock decision.

decide.approveDescription: The Customer may send the items back. Add a note if useful.
decide.rejectDescription: Nothing comes back and the units can be requested again. Say why.

restock.notYet: Each item gets its Restock decision once the Return is Received.
restock.chooseFirst: Choose a Restock decision for at least one item.

refund.title: Refund
refund.cap: At most {{cap}}. You may lower it; 0 completes the Return without a Refund.
refund.done: Return {{number}} completed with a Refund of {{amount}}.

validation.chooseItems: Enter how many units of at least one item come back.
validation.tooMany: Return at most {{max}} units of an item.
validation.amount: Enter an amount with at most two decimals.
validation.aboveCap: The Refund can be at most {{cap}}.
